    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AssetManager
    Manages the loading and caching of image assets used by the game.
    Asteroid
    A single asteroid that travels left and can bounce vertically.
    Bullet
    A single bullet fired by the player.
    CollisionManager
     
    EliteEnemyShip
    A faster, more precise enemy type: only fires when it's actually lined up with the player (no random pot-shots), but reloads quicker and closes the distance faster than a grunt — a sharper, more deliberate threat rather than a spray-and-pray one.
    EnemySpaceship
    Shared behavior for every enemy ship type: flies straight from right to left and decides each frame whether to fire at the player.
    Explosion
    A short-lived radial particle burst used when asteroids collide.
    Explosion.Particle
     
    GameClock
     
    GameController
    Controls and coordinates the overall gameplay of the Space Shooter game.
    GameController.GameState
     
    GameFrame
     
    GamePanel
    GamePanel is the main game surface — it extends JPanel so it can be added to a JFrame window, and implements Runnable so it can run the game loop on a dedicated Thread.
    GruntEnemyShip
    The basic enemy type.
    InputManager
     
    Main
     
    MenuRenderer
    MenuRenderer handles all non-gameplay screen rendering: main menu, instructions, controls, and game over screen.
    PlayerSpaceship
    The player-controlled ship.
    PowerUp
    A pickup that drifts left across the screen, same as asteroids.
    ScoreManager
     
    ShipAnimator
    ShipAnimator maps the ship's current speed to the correct sprite frame in the spritesheet.
    Spaceship
    Abstract base for anything that flies around on screen as a "ship" — shared position, size, image, and bounding box.
    SpriteSheet
    SpriteSheet slices a single PNG containing multiple sprites into an array of individual BufferedImage frames.
    Star
    Represents a small background star that moves from right to left * across the game screen.
